```lean
theorem lg_target {A : Type u_1} [AddMonoid A] [StarAddMonoid A] {r : A → A → Prop} (hr : ∀ (a b : A), r a b → r (star a) (star b)) ⦃a b : A⦄ : AddConGen.Rel r a b → AddConGen.Rel r (star a) (star b) := by
  intro H
  induction H with
  | refl => 
    constructor
    exact hr a b (refl a)
  | add H1 H2 => 
    constructor
    apply hr
    exact AddConGen.Rel.add H1 H2
```
